data.title: The Signal Tower
data.text: Here you learn Morse code by ear, one letter at a time. Each lamp on the tower is a letter: light them all.

data.title: Lessons
data.text: Letters play at full speed, with time between them; tap what you hear on the pad. Two runs in a row at 90% bring in the next letter.

data.title: Instant Recognition
data.text: Name each letter before its lamp fades. The quicker you know a sound, the less you count dots and dashes.

data.title: Sending
data.text: Key letters with the straight key: a short press is a dot, a long one a dash. The tower times your keying and shows your speed.

data.title: The Codebook
data.text: Copy whole words as they’re sent, ten at a time. Your best score stays on the door.

data.title: The Radio Room
data.text: Stations come on the air here every day. Answer one and hold a short contact, the way operators do.
